effect.name: GM Liquid Chrome
effect.desc: Image-derived liquid metal normals with environment bands, contour reflections and colored chrome tint.
effect.shader: float l(vec2 p){vec4 c=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(p,0.0,1.0));return dot(c.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722))+c.a*.25;}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0)),e=1.0/sz;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec2 g=vec2(l(uv+vec2(e.x,0))-l(uv-vec2(e.x,0)),l(uv+vec2(0,e.y))-l(uv-vec2(0,e.y)))*normalStrength;vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-g,1.0));float env=.5+.5*sin((n.y+n.x*.35)*bandScale),fres=pow(1.0-max(n.z,0.0),2.5);float metal=smoothstep(.5-roughness,.5+roughness,env);metal=clamp((metal-.5)*contrast+.5+fres*.45,0.0,1.0);vec3 result=mix(darkMetal.rgb,brightMetal.rgb,metal);result=mix(result,result*src.rgb,sourceTint);gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,result,mixAmount),src.a);}
